evidenceKind: Repository design correction, browser interaction and host tests; no new device acceptance
cause: History workspace navigation dropped exact source metadata; Inspector fallback lost kind/operation/unknown; detail groups omitted existing native fields. Browser review also exposed filter collapse, blur-only search, viewport-based columns, shared scrolling and clipped toolbar/Inspector labels.
changes: Preserve source metadata in all six readonly workspaces and Viewer/Trace forwarding; never read sample workspace files as the historical Job.
Preserve exact Inspector record identity, operation, kind and unknown state.
Project explicit summary/correlation/evidence/artifact/recovery fields and distinguish missing facts from explicit empty facts.
Use immediate search with focus/caret preservation; keep filter disclosure expanded across changes, clear/save/restore.
Use the native 890-point workspace boundary for compact activity selection, independent list/detail scrolling, and a stacked layout below 620 points.
Keep toolbar labels on one line, wrap long Inspector state chips, and preserve actual appearance labels after locale/page rendering.

earlierBuildFailure.reason: Five new page layout classes were not classified. Explicit composition roles were registered without relaxing the checker.

coverage.boundary: Inventory equality is not visual or behavioral equivalence. Existing all-page native and device results retain their own source revisions.

browserValidation.restoration: The user manually opened the allowed local HTTP preview; the existing user tab was claimed. No alternative browser or policy bypass was used.

attemptExplanations.name: combined Session and target filters stay expanded and retain the exact record
attemptExplanations.resolution: Query remained no-such-record after a bulk fill clear. Explicit keyboard select-all/backspace cleared it; all subsequent combined filter/save/restore/clear checks passed. Cause not attributed.

attemptExplanations.name: wide three-column retained recovery preserves unknown outcome
attemptExplanations.resolution: Assertion incorrectly expected a recovery epoch ID in visible text. Native RuntimeHistoryView.recoverySection renders state rather than that identifier. Corrected expectation passed without a product-code change.

attemptExplanations.name: Escape closes export and returns focus to the exact Artifact control
attemptExplanations.resolution: The assertion expected the wrong handler name. The observed button already had exact Job and Artifact attributes; a check of those DOM identities passed without product changes.

Standard export confirmation explicitly says no file was written; sensitive preview and cancel remain separate.
Exact Session/target, immediate search, empty selection, time filter, planned mode, save/clear/restore/delete.
Legacy cancelled Trace does not invent typed parameters, Artifact inventory or completed recovery.
Unresolved unknown remains in attention; resolved retained unknowns keep their original unknown outcome.
Inspector-to-History keeps exact unknown Job, operation, target and kind; full state chip fits its list column.
Single/two/three-column layouts, independent pane scrolling, long values and export controls.
Both-language dark appearance, accurate appearance label after switching language, Escape closes export and returns focus to its exact Artifact button.
